Legal consequence for residue valorization: branches, offcuts, bark, sawdust and stumps of a listed species remain legally the same species and cannot be traded internationally (raw, semi-finished or as a by-product) without a valid CITES permit and a non-detriment finding, in addition to the EU Annex documentation when the material crosses into the EU. Operators must keep provenance documentation, segregate listed-species residues in the traceability system, and record volumes separately. Check the current appendices and any annual export quota before shipping.
